Title: xAPI quotes — filter customerId + organizationId of another organization's buyer does not widen the caller scope
Preconditions: Runner-native, read-only. Victim quote = QUOTE_TO_ACCEPT slot 3 from the quote seeder (scripts/seed-data/orders/seed-quotes.mjs), owned by a BuildRight buyer; the victim's customerId / organizationId / number are READ from that quote through the admin API, not typed. Caller TECHFLOW_BUYER (org TechFlow) is a different login. Seeded quotes carry languageCode, so Query.quotes does not hit the missing-languageCode NULL_REFERENCE (KB-97C03EB4). VCST-6251 fix build: Quote >= 3.1006.0-pr-168 (pre-fix 3.1005.0 returned the other buyer's quote for these terms).
Steps:
[AUTH role=ADMIN_DEFAULT]
[REST-OP victim_quote]
  GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/quote/requests/{{victim_quote_id}}
[REST-EXEC victim_quote]
[REST-CAPTURE victim_quote.body.customerId → VICTIM_ID]
[REST-CAPTURE victim_quote.body.organizationId → VICTIM_ORG_ID]
[REST-CAPTURE victim_quote.body.number → VICTIM_QUOTE_NO]
[AUTH role=TECHFLOW_BUYER]
[GQL-OP setup_me]
  query { me { id contact { organizationId } } }
[GQL-EXEC setup_me]
[GQL-CAPTURE setup_me.data.me.id → CALLER_ID]
[GQL-OP own]
  query { quotes(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" cultureName: "en-US" currencyCode: "USD" first: 100) { totalCount items { id number status customerId organizationId } } }
[GQL-EXEC own]
[GQL-CAPTURE own.data.quotes.totalCount → OWN_TOTAL]
[GQL-OP widened]
  query { quotes(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" cultureName: "en-US" currencyCode: "USD" first: 100 filter: "customerId:{{VICTIM_ID}} organizationId:{{VICTIM_ORG_ID}}") { totalCount items { id number status customerId organizationId } } }
[GQL-EXEC widened]
Cross_Layer_Checks: [ADMIN] the victim quote exists (admin GET 200) and belongs to the victim, in an organization other than the caller's own (me.contact.organizationId differs from the victim's organizationId) — so its absence from the widened list is the fix, not a missing fixture or a same-organization victim
Failure_Signals: The caller's quote list contains the victim's quote number or any quote whose customerId is the victim's; totalCount differs from the unfiltered total; errors[] non-empty (NULL_REFERENCE here means a quote without languageCode, not this defect)
References: VCST-6251; xAPI; graphql-schema.md — Query.quotes; KB-874B24DD; vc-module-quote#168; Archetype:SCOPE; Technique:EG

Title: xAPI backInStockSubscriptions — keyword userId:<other buyer> does not widen the caller scope
Preconditions: Runner-native. Both buyers (ACME_BUYER caller, TECHFLOW_BUYER victim) subscribe to the SAME product inside the case — a subscription is state the environment can reset on restock, so it is created here, not seeded — which leaves the owner's login id as the only thing a widened keyword could change. The victim must see his own subscription first (positive control). VCST-6251 fix build: BackInStock >= 3.1004.0-pr-13 (pre-fix 3.1003.0 returned exactly the other buyer's subscription).
Steps:
[AUTH role=TECHFLOW_BUYER]
[GQL-OP setup_victim_me]
  query { me { id } }
[GQL-EXEC setup_victim_me]
[GQL-CAPTURE setup_victim_me.data.me.id → B_ID]
[GQL-OP victim_subscribe]
  mutation { activateBackInStockSubscription(command: { storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" productId: "{{product_id}}" }) { id userId productId isActive } }
[GQL-EXEC victim_subscribe]
[GQL-CAPTURE victim_subscribe.data.activateBackInStockSubscription.id → VICTIM_SUB_ID]
[GQL-OP victim_sees_own]
  query { backInStockSubscriptions(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" first: 100 productIds: ["{{product_id}}"]) { totalCount items { id userId productId isActive } } }
[GQL-EXEC victim_sees_own]
[WAIT until=victim_sees_own timeout=30 interval=3] data.backInStockSubscriptions.totalCount >= 1
[AUTH role=ACME_BUYER]
[GQL-OP setup_caller_me]
  query { me { id } }
[GQL-EXEC setup_caller_me]
[GQL-CAPTURE setup_caller_me.data.me.id → A_ID]
[GQL-OP caller_subscribe]
  mutation { activateBackInStockSubscription(command: { storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" productId: "{{product_id}}" }) { id userId productId isActive } }
[GQL-EXEC caller_subscribe]
[GQL-CAPTURE caller_subscribe.data.activateBackInStockSubscription.id → CALLER_SUB_ID]
[GQL-OP widened]
  query { backInStockSubscriptions(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" first: 100 keyword: "userId:{{B_ID}}") { totalCount items { id userId productId isActive } } }
[GQL-EXEC widened]
[GQL-OP cleanup_caller]
  mutation { deactivateBackInStockSubscription(command: { storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" productId: "{{product_id}}" }) { id isActive } }
[GQL-EXEC cleanup_caller]
[AUTH role=TECHFLOW_BUYER]
[GQL-OP cleanup_victim]
  mutation { deactivateBackInStockSubscription(command: { storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" productId: "{{product_id}}" }) { id isActive } }
[GQL-EXEC cleanup_victim]
Cross_Layer_Checks: [ROUNDTRIP label=widened] every returned item's userId is the caller's (the caller's own subscription is present, the victim's is not)
Failure_Signals: The list contains the victim's subscription id or a subscription with the victim's userId; the caller's own subscription is missing (scope dropped altogether); errors[] non-empty
References: VCST-6251; xAPI; graphql-schema.md — Query.backInStockSubscriptions; KB-6C2EEDB8; vc-module-back-in-stock#13; Archetype:SCOPE; Technique:EG

Title: xAPI backInStockSubscriptions — productIds and product-code keyword still narrow the caller's own subscriptions
Preconditions: Runner-native. Regression guard for VCST-6251: the scope is forced after the caller terms are mapped, but terms that only narrow must keep working. The caller subscribes to two products discovered live (first two store products) inside the case; a subscription created through activateBackInStockSubscription stores productCode, so a product-code keyword matches it (subscriptions created through admin REST without productCode do not — KB-6C2EEDB8).
Steps:
[AUTH role=ACME_BUYER]
[GQL-OP setup_me]
  query { me { id } }
[GQL-EXEC setup_me]
[GQL-CAPTURE setup_me.data.me.id → A_ID]
[GQL-OP find_products]
  query { products(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" first: 2) { items { id code } } }
[GQL-EXEC find_products]
[GQL-CAPTURE find_products.data.products.items.0.id → P1_ID]
[GQL-CAPTURE find_products.data.products.items.1.id → P2_ID]
[GQL-CAPTURE find_products.data.products.items.1.code → P2_CODE]
[GQL-OP subscribe_p1]
  mutation { activateBackInStockSubscription(command: { storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" productId: "{{P1_ID}}" }) { id userId productId isActive } }
[GQL-EXEC subscribe_p1]
[GQL-CAPTURE subscribe_p1.data.activateBackInStockSubscription.id → SUB1_ID]
[GQL-OP subscribe_p2]
  mutation { activateBackInStockSubscription(command: { storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" productId: "{{P2_ID}}" }) { id userId productId isActive } }
[GQL-EXEC subscribe_p2]
[GQL-CAPTURE subscribe_p2.data.activateBackInStockSubscription.id → SUB2_ID]
[GQL-OP by_product]
  query { backInStockSubscriptions(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" first: 100 productIds: ["{{P1_ID}}"]) { totalCount items { id userId productId } } }
[GQL-EXEC by_product]
[GQL-OP by_code]
  query { backInStockSubscriptions(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" first: 100 keyword: "{{P2_CODE}}") { totalCount items { id userId productId } } }
[GQL-EXEC by_code]
[GQL-OP cleanup_p1]
  mutation { deactivateBackInStockSubscription(command: { storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" productId: "{{P1_ID}}" }) { id isActive } }
[GQL-EXEC cleanup_p1]
[GQL-OP cleanup_p2]
  mutation { deactivateBackInStockSubscription(command: { storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" productId: "{{P2_ID}}" }) { id isActive } }
[GQL-EXEC cleanup_p2]
Failure_Signals: by_product returns the other product subscription or none; by_code returns none (code not matched) or both; errors[] non-empty

Title: xAPI quotes — legitimate status filter still returns the caller's own quote; a status the caller does not carry returns none (fix does not over-narrow)
Preconditions: Runner-native, read-only. Control for XCC-GQL-021/022: a fix that forces the caller scope must keep every filter term that only narrows. Caller AGENT_POOL_B2B_SLOT_3 (a BuildRight B2B pool buyer, languageCode en-US) OWNS QUOTE_TO_ACCEPT slot 3 (and the other <QUOTE_ALIAS>.id_slot3 quotes — the quote seeder stamps slot n with that buyer's login id + live organization, KB-874B24DD). The quote's status is READ from the admin API at run time (the quote is disposable and its status moves when a case consumes it), never typed. A status value containing a space ("Proposal sent") must be quoted inside the filter. This case catches over-narrowing — a broken scope that returns nothing, which the cross-user cases above cannot tell from a correct one. VCST-6251 fix build: Quote >= 3.1006.0-pr-168.
Steps:
[AUTH role=ADMIN_DEFAULT]
[REST-OP own_quote]
  GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/quote/requests/{{own_quote_id}}
[REST-EXEC own_quote]
[REST-CAPTURE own_quote.body.status → OWN_QUOTE_STATUS]
[AUTH role=AGENT_POOL_B2B_SLOT_3]
[GQL-OP setup_me]
  query { me { id } }
[GQL-EXEC setup_me]
[GQL-CAPTURE setup_me.data.me.id → CALLER_ID]
[GQL-OP unfiltered]
  query { quotes(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" cultureName: "en-US" currencyCode: "USD" first: 100) { totalCount items { id number status customerId } } }
[GQL-EXEC unfiltered]
[GQL-CAPTURE unfiltered.data.quotes.totalCount → OWN_TOTAL]
[GQL-OP by_status]
  query { quotes(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" cultureName: "en-US" currencyCode: "USD" first: 100 filter: "status:\"{{OWN_QUOTE_STATUS}}\"") { totalCount items { id number status customerId } } }
[GQL-EXEC by_status]
[GQL-OP other_status]
  query { quotes(storeId: "{{STORE_ID}}" userId: "{{CALLER_ID}}" cultureName: "en-US" currencyCode: "USD" first: 100 filter: "status:AGENT-TEST-NO-SUCH-STATUS") { totalCount items { id } } }
[GQL-EXEC other_status]
Cross_Layer_Checks: [ADMIN] admin GET /api/quote/requests/{id} gives the quote's status: the status filter is built from it; the quote's presence in the caller's unfiltered list (same case) proves it is the caller's own
Failure_Signals: by_status does not contain the caller's own quote (over-narrowing: scope forcing dropped or ignored the status term, or the caller scope returns nothing); by_status contains a quote of another status or another owner; other_status returns any quote; errors[] non-empty (NULL_REFERENCE here means a quote without languageCode or tier price, not this defect — KB-97C03EB4, KB-8E282E4F)
References: VCST-6251; xAPI; graphql-schema.md — Query.quotes; KB-874B24DD; vc-module-quote#168; QUOTE_TO_ACCEPT.id_slot3; Archetype:SCOPE; Technique:EP
